cause: The Windows Z105B Build All run passed dependency setup, build-profile validation and strict rustfmt, then cargo check --workspace --all-targets exposed remaining editor integration fallout: GridRect was absent from the world-surface test scope, a sibling structural-authoring module could not call a private result helper, the native world-surface view referenced haven_authoring without declaring it as a direct dependency, and canvas_view retained one unused camera import.

repairs.worldSurfaceTestGridRect: Import GridRect explicitly from haven_authoring in world_surface_edit/tests.rs while preserving the Z105B shared command imports.
repairs.worldResultVisibility: Widen EditorApp::finish_world_result from private to pub(crate), allowing only modules inside the native-editor crate to reuse the shared result handling path.
repairs.nativeGridRectAuthority: Use haven_editor::GridRect, the existing public re-export, in world_surface_editor.rs rather than adding a redundant direct haven_authoring dependency to haven_editor_native.
repairs.unusedCameraImport: Remove the unused CanvasCameraState import from canvas_view.rs.
